body: Issue #19 started. Acceptance rules were frozen before implementation/training (SHA256 9f5fd7739785427abee1ed67adf66b103cb0df262f5380fc652bfe6c39174d33). All five parent policies passed the 102400-state equivariance gate (max error 0), initial outputs match issue18 strict bitwise, and single-graph ONNX errors are below 7.2e-7. Three 4096-env two-update preflights passed; disabled-model/optimizer/RNG/environment states reproduce the previous sym_int continuation bitwise. Formal queue started: sym_cont/sym_wrap, five paired training seeds, 1500 updates each; both retain the original sym_int augmentation. Shared std uses one parameter per reflection orbit initialized from arithmetic parent std means; its Adam moments use orbit means with step retained, and every other restored optimizer state is unchanged. No extra training budget or default promotion. The issue background causal explanations remain hypotheses; the report will distinguish them from measured results. Task records use Notion (https://www.notion.so/403325d8231d8172995bf19510b8d760), not Linear.
